accepted_findings.title: Host-context canary check is vacuous
accepted_findings.resolution: Inject the raw canary into the host adapter environment and scan bounded Dolgorae state plus observable output for absence.

accepted_findings.title: Workspace fingerprint ignores ignored-file mutations
accepted_findings.resolution: Include ignored-path inode, size, mode, mtime, and ctime metadata in both fingerprints and add a mutating fake regression.

accepted_findings.title: Output size bound is enforced only after unbounded buffering
accepted_findings.resolution: Replace capture_output with concurrent streaming reads that kill the child immediately beyond the combined 1 MiB limit.

accepted_findings.title: Safe-failure acceptance accepts the wrong failure
accepted_findings.resolution: Require the exact PROFILE_NOT_FOUND code and retryable false for the missing-profile phase.

accepted_findings.title: Success acceptance does not validate the checked result schema
accepted_findings.resolution: Validate every live result against the checked Draft 2020-12 Specialist Review schema and registry.

accepted_findings.title: Hidden-context canary is passed directly to the Reviewer process
accepted_findings.resolution: Treat the canary as host-adapter input and prove the resolved Reviewer manifest omits it while bounded output and durable state remain canary-free.

accepted_findings.title: Recursion prevention is reported as passed without being tested
accepted_findings.resolution: Inspect the exact Reviewer Run manifest and reject any dolgorae_review registration in its process-static MCP configuration.

accepted_findings.title: Workspace mutation fingerprint excludes Git metadata
accepted_findings.resolution: Include both absolute Git dir and common-dir file metadata in the pre/post fingerprint.

accepted_findings.title: Safe-failure acceptance only tests a pre-allocation error
accepted_findings.resolution: Add an opt-in live SIGINT phase and require REVIEW_CANCELLED with no residual nonterminal engagement.

accepted_findings.title: Cancellation acceptance passes an unknown outcome
accepted_findings.resolution: Accept only the observed REVIEW_CANCELLED terminal code; interrupted-unknown cannot satisfy cancellation acceptance.

accepted_findings.title: Cleanup verification can miss a newly orphaned engagement
accepted_findings.resolution: Snapshot engagement identities and require every newly allocated engagement to finish closed.

accepted_findings.title: Hard timeout and output-limit termination can orphan descendant work
accepted_findings.resolution: Send SIGINT, drain without retaining excess bytes, allow a bounded cleanup grace, and report an explicit unknown cleanup failure before any forced termination.

accepted_findings.title: Acceptance schema permits internally contradictory evidence
accepted_findings.resolution: Replace before/after pairs with one verified fingerprint plus workspace_unchanged:true and fix round order and finding counts in the schema.
